intro: Devices that can read your encrypted messages. Remove one you no longer use: its keys are deleted and it is signed out. You can have up to 5 devices.
limitReached: You already have 5 devices. Remove one before adding another.
approvalBody: {name} ({platform}) wants to read your encrypted messages.
approvalToggle: Ask an existing device before adding a new one
approvalToggleHelp: When off, signing in on a new device creates a new security code and signs out your other devices.
waitingBody: Open Pulse on one of your other devices and tap Allow.
lostDevicesWarn: This creates a new security code and signs out all your other devices.
startFresh: This device is not registered yet.
alertOtherDevice: Your device list changed on another device.
errorApproval: Could not update the device. Try again.
